findings.summary: Hidden-field error trap: a rejected context_id is stored as typed and round-trips through the hidden input, so every later save re-raises the error, opens and badges the Connection tab, and points at a field the owner cannot see. Derived from code (admin-settings sanitize_settings context_id branch; admin-dashboard.php:1505-1528) and the existing integration test at ContextIdIntegrationTest.php:340; not reproduced in a browser.

False-green evidence: ContextIdIntegrationTest asserts the field renders and that a rejected value 'comes back in the field ... so they can correct it', but nothing checks visibility, so e8332bf passed every gate while breaking both ACs.
